newsitem.title: MEXICO: France's Chirac to visit Mexico in October - Notimex.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac to visit Mexico in October - Notimex.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo will receive his French counterpart Jacques Chirac when France's leader makes a three-day official visit to Mexico starting October 5, the state-owned news agency Notimex said on Monday.

Citing Foreign Minister Jose Angel Gurria Trevino, Notimex said Chirac will visit as a sign of French support for the start of talks between the European Union and Mexico for closer economic and political ties.
Gurria was interviewed in Mexico City's Benito Juarez international airport on his return from France.
